create_elastic_net_precomputed_gram: create an ElasticNet model with a precomputed Gram matrix and weighted samples
fit_elastic_net_weighted: fit an ElasticNet regressor with centered design matrix, precomputed gram, and sample weights
generate_regression_dataset: generate a synthetic regression dataset using make_regression with configurable noise
normalize_sample_weights: normalize sample weights to sum to the number of samples for weighted regression
compute_weighted_gram_matrix: compute a Gram matrix from a centered and weight-scaled design matrix
